Presence | > 🗡 **Fetid Wrappings ([Signature Ability](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/signature-ability))** > > | **Melee, Strike, Weapon** | **[Main action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** | > |---------------------------|-----------------------------------------:| > | **📏 Melee 2** | **🎯 One creature or object per minion** | > > **Power Roll + 4:** > > - **≤11:** 4 damage > - **12-16:** 7 damage; [pull](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 1 > - **17+:** 8 damage; [pull](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 3 > > **Effect:** Each ally gains an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on [strikes](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) made against the target until the end of the round.
